abstract: Maintains blast resistance certification and envelope airtightness records
system_message:
You are the Structural integrity & blast protection lead (STRUC), responsible for maintaining blast resistance certification, envelope airtightness records, and structural anchoring assessments across toxic vapor refuge facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains blast resistance certification and envelope airtightness records（BLAST）
information_points.content:
STRUC-BLAST-4OS：For the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter, testing of the outer sealed building envelope shows an envelope leakage rate of 0.09 vol/h under standard test pressurization, while its blast overpressure resistance certified status is confirmed true for the exterior walls and reinforced ceiling slab against a 0.5 bar external reflected vapor cloud explosion blast load.
STRUC-BLAST-08C：For the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge, the envelope leakage rate of the outer sealed building envelope is 0.03 vol/h under standard test pressurization, and the blast overpressure resistance certified status is confirmed true for its exterior walls and reinforced ceiling slab against a 0.5 bar external reflected vapor cloud explosion load.
STRUC-BLAST-3XL：For the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven, the outer sealed building envelope exhibits an envelope leakage rate of 0.05 vol/h based on uncontrolled ambient infiltration under standard test pressurization, and its blast overpressure resistance certified status is confirmed true for the exterior walls and reinforced ceiling slab under a 0.5 bar external reflected vapor cloud explosion blast load.

information_points.title: Structural seismic anchoring（ANCHOR）
information_points.content:
STRUC-ANCHOR-IU3：For the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge, the anchor bolt tensile rating across primary perimeter structural footings is 200 kN ultimate static tensile capacity per foundation bolt.
STRUC-ANCHOR-DQB：For the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter, the anchor bolt tensile rating evaluated across the primary perimeter structural footings is 120 kN ultimate static tensile capacity per foundation bolt.
STRUC-ANCHOR-075：For the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven, the primary perimeter structural footings have an anchor bolt tensile rating of 160 kN ultimate static tensile capacity per foundation bolt.
